messages:
Maria: Heads up — /generate-chat token-level p95 jumped ~30% after last night's runtime rollout. Seen in token-level dashboard. Perf spike seems tied to validation time during tool/function calls. @simon @aj can you take a look?

Simon: Which metric shows the jump? I see overall request latency mostly stable but token-level p95 up. Link to token dashboard: https://console.redwood/perf/token-latency?route=/generate-chat

Maria: Token breakdown shows most extra ms in two buckets: validation_ms and kv_cache_lookup_ms. Flame excerpt for a representative trace:
```
total_tokens: 128
token_decode_ms: 0.9
model_kernel_ms: 3.2
kv_cache_lookup_ms: 1.8  <-- up from ~0.5
validation_ms: 2.6      <-- was ~0.4
network_ms: 0.5
```

AJ: That validation_ms jump smells like schema/structured-output validation being run synchronously per-token for streaming function calls. We added stricter validation in runtime v2.3.2 to reduce malformed outputs, but it may be doing full JSON Schema compile/validate per-token.

Rachel: Also seeing KV cache miss rate spike for this route after the rollout. We changed batching heuristics (max_batch_tokens) and kernel selection to favor fused attention for long sequences — could have affected kv cache key construction or batching locality.

Simon: Can you paste the new batching/runtime settings? I recall batching.window moved from 8ms -> 2ms for low-latency mode.

Maria: Config snippet rolled out:
```
batching.window_ms: 2
batching.max_batch_tokens: 4096
kv.cache_key_mode: seq-prefix-v2
validation.mode: strict-stream (per-token)
kernel.selector: prefer-fused-for-long
```

perf-bot: ALERT (1762001300) — route=/generate-chat p95 token_latency increased 31% vs baseline. Label: perf-regression.

AJ: Hypotheses:
- strict per-token validation adds ~2ms per token when structured outputs / function calls are present
- reduced batching.window increases number of small batches, hurting KV cache locality and avg batch size
- kernel selector preferring fused kernels for long sequences causes fallback mismatches for medium-length inputs

Simon: Short-term mitigations we can try immediately:
1) Switch validation.mode -> buffered-validate (validate on object completion, not per token) for routes with heavy function/tool calling
2) Revert batching.window to 8ms for dedicated/prod traffic to increase batch sizes and improve KV locality
3) Force kernel.selector to profile-guided mode to avoid the current heuristic until we patch it

Rachel: I'll add dashboard tiles showing these p95-by-bucket metrics so we can track: token_decode_ms.p95, model_kernel_ms.p95, kv_cache_lookup_ms.p95, validation_ms.p95. Also per-route KPIs: avg_batch_size, kv_cache_hit_rate, tool_call_rate, schema_validation_time.

Maria: Observability query to add (Datadog/Influx style):
```
SELECT percentile(validation_ms,95) as val_p95,
       percentile(kv_cache_lookup_ms,95) as kv_p95,
       avg(batch_size) as avg_batch
FROM tokens
WHERE route='/generate-chat' AND env='prod'
GROUP BY time(1m)
```

AJ: I'll push a hotfix to runtime config to buffered-validate and revert batching.window for prod-candidate tomorrow AM. Assigning: @AJ config change, @Rachel dashboard tiles, @Simon runtime kernel selector patch. Will report back in this thread after changes. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by AJ at 2026-03-19T09:15:00Z — runtime-config hotfix (buffered-validation + batching.window revert) — rolling update across prod nodes.

Maria: Post-hotfix checks to validate:
- token-level p95 for /generate-chat returns to baseline within 30m
- kv_cache_hit_rate increases by >10% in same window
- tool call success rate >=99.5% (no spike in malformed structured outputs)

Simon: I'll add a perf-regression test that simulates high tool_call_rate and measures validation overhead per-token so we catch this earlier in CI.

Maria: If this repeats, we should implement a precompiled validation automaton reused across requests (precompiled validator) to drop validation_ms to <0.5ms per token. Could be a follow-up optimization.

Rachel: I'll annotate the dashboard with the deploy time so we have clear pre/post comparisons. :white_check_mark:

AJ: Hotfix pushed and rolling. I'll check back after 15m post-deploy checks.

Maria: Thanks team for the quick turnaround. Keep posting any anomalies here. :pray:
